title: Picking what to pack
titleZh: 選擇要放進包包的物品
passage:
I can fit your coat or your boots in my bag, but not both. Which could you get by without?
A. I’ll be fine in the shoes I’m wearing.
B. The boots still fit me, even with thick socks.
C. I put the bag next to the coat rack.
passageZh:
我的包包可以裝你的外套或靴子，但裝不下兩樣。哪一樣你可以不帶？
A. 我現在穿的鞋就夠用了。
B. 就算穿厚襪子，這雙靴子我還是穿得下。
C. 我把包包放在衣帽架旁。
